en: The front shows a vintage black-and-white photograph of a large outdoor terrace with many tables and chairs, neatly arranged and covered with tablecloths. The terrace is attached to a grand building with classical columns, overlooking a lush park or garden. There is text at the bottom: 'BAD PYRMONT. Kurhaus, Terrasse.' The back of the card is handwritten in old German script, has a green Deutsches Reich (German Empire) postage stamp, postal markings, and is addressed to someone in München (Munich). The card also bears the stamp of a museum in Bad Pyrmont.
